elaine: heads-up: rolling ensemble-canary (canary-1012) that routes toolcalls across two quant variants (nebula-int8 / zephyr-int4). Seeing rare parse failures that look like interleaved suffix ordering: arrays closed with parts from different model shards. ~0.9% parse_error over 2h.

raj: can you drop a raw example and the canary id?

elaine: canary-1012. replayed mirror snippet:
```
{"op":"update","items":[{"id":7,"val":"ok"},{"id":8,"val":"partial"
/* next chunk */ ,{"id":9,"val":"done"}]}
```
note the comment and comma split across chunks, caused strict parsers to choke. this looks like two different model responses concatenated out-of-order.

devbot: alert: funcall_parse_error rate for ensemble-canary = 0.9% -> 1.4% over 30m. ensemble routing enabled. threshold 0.5% breached.

syl: weird. ensemble router should serialize tool responses per-request. possibility: streaming shards flush at slightly different times and gateway merges chunks by arrival time, not by shard sequence. could we have a race in the streaming combiner?

harper: canary debug: enabled `X-Canary-Trace: shards` and captured chunk provenance. sample shows chunk order: shard-A(chunk1), shard-B(chunk1), shard-A(chunk2) where shard-B inserted an extra `,` and a stray `/*` (model commentary) that breaks JSON.

raj: mitigation options:
- short term: disable cross-variant interleaving for toolcall routes (enforce single-shard response per request)
- add lightweight combiner rewrite: detect multi-shard provenance and buffer until all shards end-of-response marker seen
- enable tolerant parser that ignores `/*...*/` style comments only on canary routes

elaine: did a quick A/B: forced single-shard routing for toolcalls in canary for 1h. parse errors dropped 0.9% -> 0.05%, p50 latency +12ms, throughput unchanged. metrics: `errors:[0.9,0.05], p50_ms:[110,122]`.

syl: good find. root cause hypothesis: quant variants differ in emitted trailing tokens (one emits human commentary like `/* ok */` after JSON). combiner assumed all shards emit pure JSON fragments and didn't sanitize interleaving.

harper: log note: token tails often include control token `0` near boundaries: `tokens: [..., 18, 0, 4]`. might be quant glue token.

raj: plan:
1) short term: keep single-shard routing for toolcall traffic until we implement safe combiner
2) syl to prototype combiner that tracks shard boundaries and only merges when sequence-contiguous (buffer at most 256 bytes per shard)
3) harper to add canary logging for any merged responses that include `/*` or stray control tokens and tag them for evaluation
4) run 24h smoke with canary gating: block prod if parse_error_rate > 0.7% for 20m

elaine: owners: @syl implement combiner, @harper add logging/traces, @raj coordinate routing toggle. I'll file ticket CAN-3009 with examples and mirror traces.

devbot: note: automated rollback policy will trigger on production routes if funcall_parse_error > 1.0% sustained for 15m.

raj: thanks. I'll keep single-shard routing in place and post 3h snapshot. :thumbsup:
